column5: Works out the best Shaman weapon imbue for each hand from your gear, spec and spell tooltips.
Rates every quest in your log and tells you which ones to abandon when you need room.
Quiet totem timers and missing-totem warnings, a shared group plan that spots overlapping totems and lets shamans settle them together, and a pulse bar that helps shamans stagger their Tremor Totems.
Quiet reminders for Soul Link, Demon Armor and your demon, plus a demon damage comparison built from your current stats.
Shows who in your party or raid has a healthstone, who used theirs and who still needs one, and who carries a soulstone.
Turns friendly player nameplates into small class-coloured dots (or class icons) with a hairline health indicator.
Scans the auction house (open it first) for revealing BoE armor that is not crafted and shows where to farm the most valuable pieces. Type /smog to open.
Marks where the members of your group died on the world map and keeps the marker after they release. Everyone with the addon shares the positions. /graves for options.

Puts your party or raid in a follow line: one player orders the line, everyone else gets a Follow button (or key) for the player ahead of them, and the window shows who is on the line and who dropped off.
One call and everyone in your group who has the addon kneels on the same beat. /kneelall
A swinging piñata over the nameplate of every enemy with Judgement of Wisdom, and a blue health bar: hit it, watch it burst, see the mana you got. /pinata for options.

Tells a Paladin when another aura fits the fight better, from the damage your party takes, pushed-back casts and enemy casters. Reminds a tank of Righteous Fury and tracks your blessings on the party. /aura for options.
Reminds you of Well Fed, the Cozy Sleeping Bag and the Camp Tent's rest, and counts the XP you lost without them. /cozy
Tells your group when you pick up a quest that can't be shared, and where to get it: quest giver, area, coordinates and a map pin anyone can click. /beacon for options.
Counts the damage and mana you throw away fighting without Lightning Shield, Water Shield or Mana Spring Totem, and mocks you for it. /shame

Advertise your slutmog wares with one click: ready-made ads for every piece on the slutmog list, or your own lines, with the next piece as an item link and its price, posted to Trade or any channel. /slutshop to open.
Plans the trip to hand in your finished quests: zone by zone and town by town, with your flight paths, hearthstone, boats and zeppelins, one numbered leg at a time.

Lists the items in your bags that are safe to destroy or sell, and says why: grey junk, quest leftovers whose quests you've done or can't take, bound gear your class can never use, things you already know. Nothing a quest still needs is ever suggested.
Levels a profession the cheapest way from your own recipes and auction prices: what to buy, what to craft and how many, what to sell. A tab in the professions window and in the auction house.

Dance for tips anywhere: emotes back at whoever looks, emotes or whispers, tip jar lines, an Accept tip button with a thank-you that grows with the tip, and a counter with your numbers. /mailslut to open.
Tracks your guild's, group's and alts' auctions and loudly says when buying one back costs less than letting it expire and lose its deposit. /deposits
Keeps the game's own swing timer bars right: a full swing starts when a cast goes off, a parry brings the next swing forward, and attack speed changes are followed in the middle of a swing. /swingfix
Your best gear for the stat weights and goals you set, planned across the whole set.

The nearest graveyard and how long the run back from it takes, for you and for enemy players. Counts down when a player you killed, a group member or you can be back at the body. /runback for options.
